question: Major hormone secreted by zona reticularis of adrenal coex ?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Zona reticularis of adrenal cortex" -> "produces sex hormones" -> "primarily androgens" -> 95%
CHAIN: "Adrenal cortex" -> "divided into three zones" -> "zona glomerulosa, zona fasciculata, zona reticularis" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Zona reticularis" -> "secretes hormones" -> "mainly androgens" -> "involved in secondary sexual characteristics" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Hormones from adrenal cortex" -> "include glucocorticoids and mineralocorticoids" -> "but zona reticularis specifically produces androgens" -> 85%
analysis: The zona reticularis of the adrenal cortex primarily secretes androgens, which are steroid hormones that contribute to the development of male characteristics and reproductive activity. While glucocorticoids and mineralocorticoids are produced in other layers of the adrenal cortex, the zona reticularis is specifically associated with androgen production.
